verdict.rationale: Stripe docs explicitly state you can charge customers in over 135 currencies and receive funds in your preferred currency, with payment links letting customers pay in their local language and currency, plus payouts to bank accounts and automated tax compliance (VAT/GST/sales tax) across transactions. This directly covers charging in local currency, settling to founder's own currency, and transparent handling of related financial/tax mechanics. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of FX conversion rates/fees transparency or independent corroboration of settlement accuracy from hands-on users.
